name: Maha Strategies Inbound Gatekeeper

offerSelectionGuide.description: Machine-readable Maha offer selection guide: which x402 offer to call, or neither.

capabilities.description: Calculate seven classical-body geocentric longitudes at one UTC instant in Tropical and versioned Lahiri Sidereal frames. Includes explicit conventions and a deterministic integrity receipt. Public or synthetic inputs only. No interpretations, forecasts, LLM calls, or predictive certification. Bodies and receipt digests are not stored.

Calculate one UTC chart with Tropical and Lahiri Sidereal positions, Sidereal whole-sign houses, mean nodes, geometric aspects and panchanga. Includes numerical limitations and a deterministic integrity receipt. Public or synthetic inputs only. No forecasting narrative, LLM calls or predictive certification. Bodies and receipt digests are not stored.

Calculate Vimshottari birth balance, nine mahadashas and nine antardashas of the active mahadasha at one reference instant. Uses actual nakshatra stay time and a 365.2425-day year. Includes conventions and deterministic receipt. Public or synthetic inputs only. No event prediction, interpretation or LLM calls. Bodies and receipt digests are not stored.

capabilities.provides: five deterministic source-linked Context Packs at five ascending token budgets
capabilities.retention: Request and response bodies are not stored.

capabilities.measures: exact retention of caller-labelled required-evidence spans

capabilities.provides: five exact-span evidence-retention evaluations and a budget frontier
capabilities.retention: Documents, evidence spans, compiled packs, and response bodies are not stored.

capabilities.provides: automated claim triage with provenance statuses

payment.note: Payable autonomously over x402 v2 on Base Mainnet. Requires an idempotency key and an input hash over the text field; request identity, JSON body and hash are checked before settlement. A replayed request returns the job already paid for rather than charging twice. Retrieval and resume at the retrieval endpoint are free.

capabilities.retention: The complete submitted passage is not retained. Results retain short verbatim claim excerpts, classifications, rationales, hashes, and operational metadata.

capabilities.provides: a machine-readable context-control evidence packet with policy, budget, integrity, and receipt fields
capabilities.retention: Documents, evidence spans, compiled packs, and response bodies are not stored.

capabilities.provides: machine-generated research intake evidence packet for one question and up to ten supplied source sections
capabilities.sourceHandling: Only public or synthetic, non-sensitive source sections are accepted. The request must explicitly authorize transmission of those sections to Anthropic for processing.

payment.note: Payable autonomously over x402 v2 on Base Mainnet. Completed section audits are checkpointed and never rerun when a sibling section fails.

capabilities.retention: Complete supplied sections are transmitted to Anthropic for processing but are not retained by Maha. Results retain the question, supplied source and section identifiers, optional intake metadata, short verbatim claim excerpts, classifications, digests, and operational metadata.

capabilities.provides: one exact machine-readable section of The Imagined Life with integrity metadata and a deterministic receipt
capabilities.retention: The request and delivered section are returned transiently and are not stored by this endpoint.

capabilities.provides: one exact machine-readable section of The Volcanic Engine with integrity metadata and a deterministic receipt
capabilities.retention: The request and delivered section are returned transiently and are not stored by this endpoint.

capabilities.provides: the complete normalized Markdown edition of The Imagined Life with an ordered section manifest and deterministic receipt
capabilities.retention: The request and complete delivered edition are returned transiently and are not stored by this endpoint.

capabilities.provides: the complete normalized Markdown edition of The Volcanic Engine with an ordered section manifest and deterministic receipt
capabilities.retention: The request and complete delivered edition are returned transiently and are not stored by this endpoint.

capabilities.description: Compare up to 20 declared source identities, revisions and locators. Returns exact mismatches and an integrity receipt. Does not fetch sources, establish passage existence or verify claim support.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Check one initial or superseding revision transition against a declared predecessor. Returns lineage inconsistencies and an integrity receipt. Does not establish authenticity, semantic equivalence or inherited review approval.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Normalize up to 100 metadata events into deterministic order, rejecting duplicate identifiers and malformed times or digests. Does not prove event occurrence, provenance or completeness against an external system.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Multiply or divide two seven-component SI dimension vectors and compare with the expected output dimension. No unit conversion, formula validation, scale-factor inference or physical-model certification.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Interpolate between two integer-coordinate points with exact rational arithmetic and an integrity receipt. Refuses extrapolation and repeated nodes. Does not estimate measurement error or validate the interpolation model.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Apply the composite trapezoidal rule to 2-128 equally spaced integer samples. Returns an exact rational arithmetic result, declared units and an integrity receipt. No quadrature-error estimate or claim of an exact underlying integral.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Compare 2-20 caller-labelled observations of one claim, population and outcome. Returns opposing directions and explicitly excluded observations. No literature search, source inspection, consensus judgment or factual verification.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Deliver public source metadata and exact release bindings for one supported federation article at caller-pinned revisions. Uses the deployed repository snapshot, not a live registry probe. No private review material, full source text or expert certification.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Deliver one supported atlas unit as structured edition metadata, poetic context, bounded answers and links at a pinned registry digest. Public pages remain free. No translation full text, redistribution license, historical or theological certification.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

capabilities.description: Check one structured public or synthetic low-stakes experiment plan for timing, comparator, outcome and analysis declarations. Returns deficiencies and an integrity receipt. No registration, trusted timestamp, prediction, power analysis or scientific validation.
blockedBy: Local implementation only; owner publication approval, Preview verification and paid canaries outstanding.

terms.payment: Eleven bounded machine products are payable autonomously on Base Mainnet. A live PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge is the only proof an offer can be bought. The GPU optimization routes are not x402 products. A human purchaser must authorize Stripe Checkout; custom research and enterprise work require human scope review.
terms.sensitiveData: Do not submit confidential, regulated, or sensitive personal information.
